base_member_text: [L2-L9,L36] (MED/zero-size-array-address) For every array the template takes C_LOC of the element at its lower bounds without checking SIZE, which is an invalid element reference when any generated array is empty.
audit_member_text: [L2-L9,L34-L36] (LOW/invalid address for empty array) For every array the template unconditionally takes `c_loc` of its lower-bound element, which does not exist when any generated variable has zero total size.

adversarial.rationale: This is reachable after normal serial initialization: initialize.F90:501-511 allocates cgx_s, cgy_s, ctheta_s and ee_s with zero extents when single_dir is not one, and variables.def:75-78 exposes them to the generator. The ASSOCIATED check in templates/indextos.mako:32-36 only sets a temporary descriptor and does not stop get_var, whose lower-bound element reference remains unconditional; no subsequent initialization gives these pointer targets nonzero size.

base_member_text: [L27-L28,L31-L38] (MED/stale-output-on-failure) Unknown names and recognized names absent from the generated select cases return without assigning x, so the caller can retain an unrelated incoming pointer with no status result.
audit_member_text: [L17,L27-L38] (MED/stale output on lookup failure) The output pointer is `intent(inout)` and is never initialized to `C_NULL_PTR`, so an unknown name or any mismatch between `chartoindex` and the generated cases returns the caller's previous or uninitialized pointer value.

adversarial.rationale: Unknown names really leave x unchanged: mnemonic.F90:43-48 logs a warning and returns -1, followed by the unassigned return in get_var.mako:27-28. However, the claimed recognized-name/case mismatch is not present in a consistent build, because chartoindex.mako:9-14 and get_var.mako:31-37 enumerate the same variables list supplied by scripts/generate.py:149-166,239-251; retain the defect only for unknown-name failure, with a log diagnostic rather than completely silent failure.

base_member_text: [L16,L19,L25] (MED/unterminated-c-string-contract) The assumed-size C character input is scanned via strlen with no explicit length bound, so correctness and memory safety rely on an undocumented guarantee that the caller supplies a reachable NUL terminator.

[L36] (MED/c-interoperability-contract) C_LOC is generated for every listed variable without this template enforcing or documenting the required TARGET/POINTER, interoperable-type, and storage-contiguity properties.

[L22-L23,L29] (LOW/dead-or-missing-validation) indextos populates the local array descriptor but that descriptor is never read, making the call either dead work or evidence of a missing validation step.
